item.g:description: A high quality leather belt featuring intricate laser engraved psychedelic patterns inspired by the twisting form of a futuristic serpent. A distinctive statement piece for festivals, alternative fashion or everyday wear. Buckle is easily removable and can be replaced for custom buckle. When choosing your size be sure to measure your existing belt size as explained in the picture below.

item.g:title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala - 30cm
item.g:description: The seven pointed star known as a Septagram or Heptagram has various different meanings within religious and occult beliefs. As an early prime number, the number seven has greatly symbolic associations in religion, mythology, superstition and philosophy. It is considered lucky in western culture and is often seen as highly symbolic. It is considered a sacred symbol with magical power in various modern a pegan witchcraft traditions. These beautiful self illuminating light sculpture feature 7 way symmetry and are made from 7 layers of wood with 7 small septagrams within the whole, the first 7 pieces are also individually numbered out of 7. If the number 7 has a significance within your beliefs or you simply wish to have a beautifully crafted art piece that brings you good luck then this piece can be a great edition to your home. Each piece comes with a stand and a D ring on the rear so it can either be free standing or hung on a wall. This first run of 10 pieces are for the collectors as they are all individually numbered.

item.g:title: Platonic Energy Circle, LED Sacred Geometry Wall Mandala - 60cm
item.g:description: The Platonic Energy Circle is a beautiful self illuminating wooden mandala wall sculpture packed with sacred geometry symbolism. This portal of sacred beauty, lights up with the discrete application of color changing LED lighting to create an amazing sight and energy to behold both for night and day. The front most layer features a large mandala made from 12 intersecting circles with 2 dimensional representations of the platonic solids marking each intersection. From the center moving outward you can find a tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron followed by an icosahedron. The second layer repeats this design and is painted silver to add an additional layer of depth which is emphasized with the use of the integrated LED lighting which highlights the silver differently from the third layer behind it. The third layer features alternating patterns based on variants of the flower of life pattern, by changing the size of the individual circles that create this patterns as well as changing the shape of these circles to hexagons these new patterns were manifested. This piece has been meticulously designed with 100% geometric accuracy, precision cut with laser technology from multiple layers of Birch wood, and finally painted and assembled by hand. The integrated LED lighting can be adjusted with the use of the small controller and features a 3 meter long discrete white power cable and a choice of different international AC adapters.
